summary: Validated 3 security features: (1) Turnstile enforcement on /api/auth/registro (400 without token, 200 with any token — test secret), plus frontend widget renders 'Success!' on Registro tab and full happy-path register works; (2) MongoDB-backed shared RateLimiter — rate_limits collection populates with ip:bucket docs and TTL index on expire_at exists; (3) Admin Painel de Segurança backend + UI: /seguranca/resumo, /login-bloqueios, /webhooks-suspeitos protected, cards + tables + list render; forged SyncPay webhook returns 200 with no state mutation and appears in 'Webhooks suspeitos' list (count 2→3 after refresh). Regression: admin login, /auth/me, public /assinaturas/planos and /configuracoes/landing OK; admin cupom endpoints require admin (403). 13/13 pytest tests pass.
critical_code_review_comments: services/turnstile_service.py returns (True, []) when TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY unset — silent bypass. Consider explicit warning log on startup so ops know protection is off.
routes/seguranca.py /resumo webhooks_suspeitos_24h counts ALL time (not last 24h) despite variable name; align name or add a created_at filter.

security.py RateLimiter TTL doc sets expire_at to window+block_duration=120s; that's fine, but the get_retry_after ignores actual bucket start (uses current second) — acceptable but slightly imprecise.
seed_data_creation: None persisted — created QA users and forged webhook logs were cleaned up (db.usuarios _qa@, security_logs FORGED-*).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Test file /app/backend/tests/test_security_panel.py covers Turnstile enforcement, /api/seguranca/* admin auth+data, forged SyncPay webhook flow, MongoDB rate_limits shared store, and regression endpoints. UI data-testids used: turnstile-widget, tab-registro, submit-button, admin-seguranca-page, table-contas, table-ips, list-webhooks, btn-refresh-seguranca, toggle-auto-refresh. Cloudflare TEST keys in envs (site 1x00000000000000000000AA / secret 1x0000000000000000000000000000000AA) accept any non-empty response token.
